corrections.reason: The printed text in Column 2, Line 25 clearly shows 'ባየች' (4th order ባ followed by 1st order የ, meaning 'when she saw', translating Ge'ez 'ወርእያ'), which was transposed in Stage 1 as 'በያች'.
The word 'ጊዜውንም' splits across the line break from Line 33 ('ጊዜ') onto Line 34 ('ውንም').
The middle character in 'በደህና' is 6th-order ህ (with the bent left leg), standard Amharic for 'in peace/well', misread as 1st-order ሀ.
